name: Introw Partner Connect
description: Introw Partner Connect lets your partners bring their own AI assistant into the partnership. Once connected, a partner can check their pipeline and deal stages, track commission status and payouts, see tier and goal progress, register a deal or share a lead, add comments and manage tasks on shared records, and get instant answers from your enablement content and knowledge base - all from Claude, scoped to exactly what their portal account can see. Every read is limited to the partner's own permissions, and every write is attributed to that partner user and synced back to the CRM through Introw. Partners connect once and it works across every vendor portal they have access to.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Introw Partner Connect to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Introw Partner Connect to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://partners.introw.io/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Introw Partner Connect MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Introw Partner Connect lists 16 MCP tools, including add_comment, add_task, deal_coaching, find_relevant_content, get_commission_information, get_goals, get_marketing_funds_information, get_tier_information, partners, search_crm_objects, search_form_submissions, and search_partner_engagement.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Introw Partner Connect?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Introw Partner Connect in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.

_published_faq.name: Does Introw Partner Connect MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Introw Partner Connect requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Introw Partner Connect is developed by Introw. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
